implementation_map.behavior: Infer correction/polish versus improvement/new drafting; inspect whole requested work; improvement searches for a better thought, structure or expression even if adequate; no local-failure prerequisite.
implementation_map.retired: Global smallest-diff interpretation, defect-only trigger, serial one-at-a-time constraint and mandatory exact-plan workflow for every saved edit.
implementation_map.limits: Correction-only/fixed-order/protected wording constraints remain; improvement does not require a rewrite if no candidate earns its tradeoff.

implementation_map.behavior: Separate author conclusion, supported connective and proposed interpretation; test useful alternative/boundary and develop grounded claim without inventing premise or endorsement.
implementation_map.retired: Treating a cautious model bridge as sufficient grounds for an author thesis; preserving a revisable recommendation as though it were a fact.
implementation_map.limits: Only materially blocking evidence/intent leads to a question; unaffected work continues; no exhaustive map for ordinary connective edits.

implementation_map.behavior: Compare a meaningful dependency/condition/experience change through actual decisive prose; select and execute a warranted local or coordinated revision.
implementation_map.retired: Mandatory two drafts, superficial renamed alternatives, analytic productivity requirement for artistic effects, minimum footprint as merit.
implementation_map.limits: Comparison is conditional and proportional; unclear effect/original can stand; model judgment is not reader success.

implementation_map.behavior: Gate ambiguity resolution by ordinary action versus explicit definition/boundary/annotation/reliability objective; preserve unassessed/absent/unresolved and independent research disagreement.
implementation_map.retired: Forcing exhaustive runtime labels or dismissing research disagreement because no edit would change.
implementation_map.limits: Twelve IDs retained; original source labels/units stay distinct; presence/adequacy/truth and anchors/full extents separate; no new validator or gold claims.

implementation_map.behavior: Preserve author authority, actual constraints, meaningful terms, voice, source scope, attribution and factual status.
implementation_map.retired: Inferred literal locks from meaning preferences; equating strangeness with intended voice.
implementation_map.limits: Approved mandatory style/article copies unchanged and identical; supported correction of erroneous or overstated source claims remains contextual.

implementation_map.behavior: Visible Family→Form→Section for substantial planning/structural work; functional blanks; nine descriptive feature groups; ranges/targets/limits separated.
implementation_map.retired: Source sentence stems, platform-based form defaults, observed medians as targets.
implementation_map.limits: No required printed headings, taxonomy quiz, new family inventory or numerical profiles.

implementation_map.behavior: Use real supported contracts on final scoped bytes; inspect per-check status/enforcement/advisories; review semantic remainder separately.
implementation_map.retired: Generic pass claims, stale receipt reuse, false body-scope inference and file-hash claims about later chat delivery.
implementation_map.limits: Scripts unchanged: exact literal and max-word/growth contract; other real constraints need separate checks; editor can use an available counter without writer helper.

implementation_map.behavior: Explain choices when requested or part of learning; practice after writing when chosen; requested worked solution delivered directly.
implementation_map.retired: Homework after a rationale request or attempt-first blocking a worked solution.
implementation_map.limits: No acceptance-as-learning claim or mandatory exercise.
